# M001 "The First Flame" — Implementation Report

Engine: Godot 4.3-stable (GL Compatibility). Language: GDScript (~8,000 lines). Date: 2026-11-01.
Everything below marked **tested** was executed headless (or under a virtual X display for screenshots)
in this build environment. Nothing here was run on an Android device.

---

The generator asserts the 160/110/15/150 counts, the exact per-tier counts, unique IDs and that every prerequisite exists.

### Implemented dwarves (18) — all with movement, targeting, attack/support, health, death, cost, cooldown, procedural art
Tunnel Militia · Ironhold Rifleman (visible reload with ramrod, recoil, muzzle flash) · Shieldbearer (taunt, frontline) ·
Blunderbussier (5-target cone, hits low-diving flyers) · Grenadier (arcing blast) · Field Mechanic (repairs vehicles/walkers/artillery, finite 900-HP parts crate) ·
Light Field Cannon (AP, outranges early undead) · Flak Crew (air-only, airburst) · Organ Gun (7-barrel rippling volley) ·
Brasshound Armored Car · Copperback Light Tank (independent cannon + coax MG) · Miner Rig (walker, drill bonus vs bone/stone, +1.6 Gold/s prospecting) ·
Boiler Stomper (walker: telegraphed AoE stomp + steam vent that hits low flyers) ·
Dwarven Flying Machine (interceptor: hunts flyers, strafes when sky is clear, retreats to repair <30% HP) ·
Scout Gyro (spotter: artillery +20% range/+15% damage, reveals burrowed enemies) ·
Bombard Gyro (attack runs with 4 bombs, returns to rearm) ·
Ironwing Gunship (belly cannon on ground + dorsal turret on air, independently) ·
Ironcloud Airship (two broadsides + swivel flak, three independent weapons).

### Implemented undead (14) + boss
Rotter · Zombie Miner (tunnels under the line, emerges near dwarves) · Grave Crawler (slips under the front, hunts crews; halves blast damage) ·
Plague Runner (death burst) · Ossuary Skeleton (bone: resists bullets) · Bone Shieldbearer (−70% pierce) · Grave Knight (telegraphed cleave) ·
Bone Archer · Rot Spitter (acid, bonus vs machine armor) · Necromancer (raises Rotters from corpses with a glowing telegraph; capped) ·
Flesh Hulk (telegraphed slam that lands where the target *was* — dodgeable) · Carrion Bat (dive-bite swarms) ·
Plague Shrieker (anti-aircraft flyer) · Bone Spire (structure, prioritises aircraft).
**Mine Maw** (Stage 010): surface → burrow (telegraph) → tunnels to densest dwarven formation (untargetable unless a Scout Gyro spots it) →
cracking-ground telegraph → eruption (AoE + knock-back + spits Rotters) → exposed (+50% damage taken) → repeat; enrages under 35%.
Support waves every 19 s, capped at 10 alive, stop when it dies. Its life seals the citadel (visible necrotic seal).

### Campaign — Stages 001–015 (Act I)
Authored tracks with ramping intervals, timed events, citadel-damage triggers, structures, hazards (rockfall with dust telegraph; gale that buffets aircraft),
deterministic per-stage seed, alive caps, late escalation. Air combat from Stage 001. Boss at 010. 011–015 combine familiar enemies.
Rewards: Forge Sparks + blueprints (S1 Grenadier, S2 Blunderbussier, S3 Scout Gyro, S4 Miner Rig, S5 Organ Gun, S6 Brasshound, S7 Field Mechanic);
Stage 002 opens T1 research; Stage 015 opens T2 research (Copperback, Boiler Stomper, Bombard Gyro). Ironwing and Ironcloud are T3: playable in the
Test Sandbox only in M001, as the spec allows. Cleared stages reveal their enemy lineup and boss; uncleared ones don't. No stage-type announcements.

### Systems
Shared Gold economy (+ kill bounty, 4 mine upgrades) · Steam Pressure (advanced-machine costs, **Overdrive**: machines +50% fire rate/+30% speed 8 s;
**Pressure Vent**: scalding blast in front of the stronghold) · independent `Weapon` components (own target, range, arc, reload, rotation, projectile, windup, burst) ·
spatial x-buckets for target queries · sticky targeting with priority classes (nearest/air/armored/swarm/structure/support/threat) ·
ground formation (ranged + artillery hold behind the front; lane spreading) · lightweight aircraft steering · pooled projectiles that never chase dead targets ·
fixed-capacity particle pool (halved in performance mode) · off-screen draw culling · versioned JSON save with `.bak` + migration ·
3 loadout presets (7 ground / 4 air / 1 flex, no hero slot) · settings (volumes, quality 60/30 FPS, shake, default speed, reset).

### Screens
Main Menu (animated forge), Campaign Map, Army Loadout, Great Forge, Unit Compendium, Settings, Battle (HUD: stronghold/citadel bars, Gold, Steam gauge,
12 deploy cards with cooldown sweep and cost, abilities, minimap, pause, 1×/2×, boss bar, one rate-limited alert), Victory, Defeat, Pause, **Test Sandbox**
(spawn any unit for either side by tapping, §14 scenarios A–J, toggles for infinite gold / invulnerable bases / target lines / health bars / auto-commander /
Stage-015 waves, live diagnostics).

### Art & audio
All visuals are original procedural layered polygons drawn from code (no external or copyrighted assets): 18 dwarves, 14 undead, boss, 2 strongholds,
9 painted environments, UI theme. Animated: walk cycles, recoil, muzzle flashes, rifle reload, crew operation, track/wheel rotation, mech leg and piston motion,
rotors/propellers, banking, airship turrets, undead shamble/lunge/dive, telegraphed wind-ups, death falls and wrecks.
All audio is synthesized at startup in 22 separate categories plus two procedural music loops (industrial percussion over a drone) and 4 ambiences.

## 3. Limitations (honest)

- **Not device-tested.** No FPS figure on Android has been measured. The stress numbers above are logic-only on a server CPU; rendering cost on a phone is unknown.
- **APK caveat.** No Android SDK could be downloaded here, so the export validator was satisfied with stub `adb`/`apksigner` files and the APK was zipaligned and
  debug-signed afterwards with uber-apk-signer. For a release build use a real SDK, JDK 17+, and your own keystore.
- **Art is procedural, not hand-painted.** It is original, readable, consistent and animated, but it is code-drawn vector art, not final sprite artwork.
- **Audio is synthesized placeholder quality**, not final sound design or an orchestral soundtrack.
- **Difficulty tuning is provisional.** The heuristic auto-commander wins every stage while keeping its stronghold near full health, so early stages may feel
  easy to an attentive player; Stage 014 was softened (one forward Bone Spire instead of two deep ones) after it stalemated the bot. Needs human playtesting.
- In Test E the Copperback's two weapons chose the same target (both are valid choices there); independent multi-weapon targeting is demonstrated by the
  Ironwing and Ironcloud (domain-split weapons) rather than the tank.
- Loadouts expose all 12 slots from the start (no slot-unlock progression).
- Copperback, Boiler Stomper and Bombard Gyro become researchable only after Stage 015 (Age of Steam); Ironwing Gunship and Ironcloud are sandbox-only in M001.
- Godot prints benign "ObjectDB instances leaked at exit" warnings when headless test processes quit.
